scope: external Wi-Fi XCTest startup, not on-device RSD startup
hint: over Wi-Fi the iPhone did not authorize the device runner's UI-automation session (code 74, testmanagerd refused the IDE channel after waiting; setup_message has the wait) — iOS cannot show the passcode prompt over Wi-Fi, and some iOS versions refuse it entirely; connect the iPhone by USB and have a person enter the passcode when it asks, and keep it on USB if Wi-Fi still fails afterwards; retrying over Wi-Fi cannot fix this (the managed service waits 15 minutes between attempts and retries at once when the phone is plugged in), so do not send another reconnect request
